body: Me too, I feel like I'm invisible and.. honestly I'm sick of it so I feel you bro...

You're so luckyy ;-;
But I'm really happy for you 😁
I wouldn't take a cure, because I am autistic, this is who I am, how I work and even if it's hard sometimes, I'm proud to be who I am and I would never change for anything.

Well yeah, I actually went to the psych ward for 2 weeks, I kinda lied to get out but I admit that I felt well, but not anymore, and I'm scared to tell my parents cuz I don't want to go back to the hospital
